static exr_result_t
DwaCompressor_readChannelRules (
    DwaCompressor* me, const uint8_t** dataPtr, uint64_t* dataLeft, uint64_t* ruleSize)
{
    uint64_t ruleSize;
    uint64_t numRules;
    uint64_t i;

    if (*dataLeft < 8) return EXR_ERR_CORRUPT_CHUNK;

    ruleSize = *(const uint64_t*) *dataPtr;
    priv_to_native64 (&ruleSize, 1);
    *dataPtr += 8;
    *dataLeft -= 8;

    if (ruleSize > *dataLeft) return EXR_ERR_CORRUPT_CHUNK;

    numRules = ruleSize / 8;

    for (i = 0; i < numRules; ++i)
    {
        uint64_t rule;
        if (*dataLeft < 8) return EXR_ERR_CORRUPT_CHUNK;
        rule = *(const uint64_t*) *dataPtr;
        priv_to_native64 (&rule, 1);
        *dataPtr += 8;
        *dataLeft -= 8;
    }

    *ruleSize = ruleSize;
    return EXR_ERR_SUCCESS;
}

static exr_result_t
DwaCompressor_readChannelRules (
    DwaCompressor* me, const uint8_t** dataPtr, uint64_t* dataLeft, uint64_t* ruleSize)
{
    uint64_t ruleSize;
    uint64_t numRules;
    uint64_t i;

    if (*dataLeft < 8) return EXR_ERR_CORRUPT_CHUNK;

    ruleSize = *(const uint64_t*) *dataPtr;
    priv_to_native64 (&ruleSize, 1);
    *dataPtr += 8;
    *dataLeft -= 8;

    if (ruleSize > *dataLeft) return EXR_ERR_CORRUPT_CHUNK;

    numRules = ruleSize / 8;

    for (i = 0; i < numRules; ++i)
    {
        uint64_t rule;
        if (*dataLeft < 8) return EXR_ERR_CORRUPT_CHUNK;
        rule = *(const uint64_t*) *dataPtr;
        priv_to_native64 (&rule, 1);
        *dataPtr += 8;
        *dataLeft -= 8;
    }

    *ruleSize = ruleSize;
    return EXR_ERR_SUCCESS;
}
